analysis.title: Logitech (LOGN.S): 2QFY27 First Take: Above cons non-GAAP EBIT with strong demand in Gaming and VC
key_insights: Logitech 2QFY27 revenue of $1,219mn was 0.7% above Visible Alpha consensus ($1,211mn) and up 2.8% yoy as reported (2% in cc). Growth came from Gaming, Video Collaboration, Pointing devices, Keyboards and combos, partly offset by Webcams and Tablet Accessories.

Non-GAAP EBIT of $231mn was 13.4% above consensus ($204mn) and ahead of the company's $185-210mn guide. Non-GAAP gross margin was 45.2% vs 43.9% consensus, and non-GAAP EPS was $1.51 vs $1.31 consensus.

Regional split: Americas sales rose 13% yoy in cc on Enterprise demand and resilient consumer spend. Asia Pacific fell 2% yoy in cc on tough comps, with China growing faster than the region. EMEA fell 6% yoy in cc on weak consumer demand and lower customer confidence.

A semiconductor component supplier had a serious incident at its manufacturing facility. It reopened the site in September and is ramping production, but output is still below Logitech's needs. The company expects full production by the end of the calendar year.
The supplier issue implies a $70-80mn revenue headwind in 3QFY27, versus the roughly $200mn the company expected before. Logitech expects the issue to be fully resolved by 4QFY27.

3QFY27 guidance: revenue of $1.36-1.43bn (-4% to +1% yoy in USD, -5% to 0% in cc), non-GAAP gross margin of 41-42% vs 43.5% Visible Alpha consensus, and non-GAAP operating income of $220-255mn. Revenue guidance is 6% above consensus, while EBIT guidance is 1% below consensus at the mid-point.

GS expects an initial mixed stock reaction: the quarter beat and Video Collaboration grew 12% yoy in cc, but next quarter's EBIT guide is below consensus and Europe and Asia demand is weak. The stock has outperformed EU Tech by 10% in the last month and is up 14% YTD.
GS reiterates Buy with a 12-month price target of SFr95, based on 21x 2HCY27+1HCY28 adjusted EPS. The price of SFr91.96 implies 3.3% upside.

market_movers.rationale: 2QFY27 non-GAAP EBIT beat consensus by 13.4% and Gaming and Video Collaboration demand was strong. The 3QFY27 EBIT guide is 1% below consensus at the mid-point and Europe and Asia are weak.

earnings_insights: Logitech 2QFY27 (reported 10/27-28): non-GAAP revenue $1,219mn vs GS est $1,210mn and Visible Alpha consensus $1,211mn (+0.7% vs cons, +2.8% yoy).
Non-GAAP EBIT reported $231mn (18.9% margin) vs GS est $207mn and consensus $204mn (+13.4% vs cons). Company guide was $185-210mn.
Non-GAAP EPS reported $1.51 vs GS est $1.33 and consensus $1.31 (+15.2% vs cons).
Non-GAAP gross profit reported $551mn (45.2% margin) vs consensus $532mn (43.9% margin).

Segment results vs consensus: Pointing Devices $230mn (+3.5%), Keyboards and Combos $246mn (+8.0%), PC Webcams $76mn (-3.6%), Tablet and Other Accessories $58mn (-32.0%), Video Collaboration $188mn (+2.3%, +12.4% yoy), Gaming $349mn (+1.4%, +8.0% yoy), Headsets $46mn (+6.2%).

3QFY27 company guidance (forecast): revenue $1.36-1.43bn (6% above VA consensus), non-GAAP gross margin 41-42% vs VA consensus 43.5%, non-GAAP operating income $220-255mn (1% below consensus at the mid-point).
GS estimates: FY3/27E revenue $4,877.7mn, EBIT $773.9mn, EPS $4.93. FY3/28E revenue $5,179.6mn, EBIT $834.3mn, EPS $5.53. Quarterly EPS estimates: 9/26E $1.12, 12/26E $1.19, 3/27E $0.98.
risk_factors: Weaker end markets and negative macro dynamics.
Weak consumer demand and lower customer confidence in EMEA, and tough comps in Asia Pacific.
Semiconductor component supplier ramp-up: current output is below Logitech's requirements, with a $70-80mn revenue headwind in 3QFY27 and full resolution expected only by 4QFY27.
3QFY27 non-GAAP gross margin guide of 41-42% is well below the 43.5% consensus.
vol_and_positioning: Logitech has outperformed EU Tech by 10% in the last month and is up 14% YTD in absolute terms.

tension_points.bear_case: The 3QFY27 non-GAAP EBIT guide is 1% below consensus at the mid-point, gross margin guide of 41-42% is below the 43.5% consensus, and demand is weak in Europe and Asia.
